items.title: Separate protocol Gateway state from Server session identity
items.summary: Treat Client slot/pipeline/mode as transport metadata; Server session identity is a separate self-defined concept.

items.title: Keep account authentication policy independent of historical Client wire evidence
items.summary: Implement test account authentication/storage in the separate Server repository under explicit policy; do not infer original Server persistence or password storage from E8/000F.

items.title: Server-authoritative character records with client-compatible serialization boundary
items.summary: Separate server-owned character roster selection/authorization from the byte geometry consumed by the KR Client; do not assign semantics to unknown 65-byte prefix fields.
